versions.changelog:
Initial release of jianying-ai-text-video-infinite:

- Automates the AI text-to-video feature in the Jianying desktop client (not the web version).
- Converts user-provided shot scripts into videos with pre-set options: future sci-fi theme, single-take storyboard, 9:16 video ratio, and female podcast voice-over.
- Reads all UI click coordinates from `jianying_coords.json`; does not hardcode positions.
- Ensures correct clipboard-based pasting for Chinese text input; typewrite is disabled for non-ASCII.
- Contains robust workflow and critical lessons (such as single window activation, not matching window title by string, correct order of dropdown/scroll actions).
- Pauses for user confirmation before generating the video to prevent unintentional actions.
